overall_notes: Round 2 retrofit clears the strict bar with all six categories at 4. Sowder (1992) benchmark estimation + NCTM number-sense trajectories cited in expanded_walkthrough.rationale. Three diagnostic-branched recovery_moves (DIAGNOSTIC A single-count for big jars, DIAGNOSTIC B wildly-off estimate, DIAGNOSTIC C estimates-without-reasoning) give a sub a clear if/then path. Tina's estimation refrain 'Pick the chunk that fits the jar! Small jar — chunk of TEN! Big jar — chunk of HUNDRED!' anchors minds_on, action step 5, and the exit_routine. NO-JAR clap version is in differentiation.for_movement_learners ('teacher claps a chunk of 10 then keeps clapping; child estimates total claps by chunk-counting. Body becomes the jar') so the lesson runs with zero prep. STRATEGY COMPARE is action step 5 — two pairs share their chunk-of-10 vs chunk-of-100 estimates for the same jar and the class debates which size matches. Worksheet Part 3 (hockey-arena estimate) is a transfer task that varies the format from the jar work, justifying L4 on consistency. Tina puppet is explicitly OPTIONAL with substitutes named.
